name: creativity-is-engineering
description: Creativity dimensions with stable gate ids. An insight that only lives in chat is not creativity.

dimensions.title: 不删优势
dimensions.summary: If the operator names a behavior as an advantage, lock it. Do not optimize the moat.

dimensions.title: 先分段再动
dimensions.summary: No timing, no optimization. Parallel stages use max, not sum.

dimensions.title: 一种失败一种动作
dimensions.summary: The first AI output is a classifier over real text, not a faster fill().

dimensions.title: 三张皮一层肉
dimensions.summary: HTTP, IPC, and tests converge on one service. A long-run shell is not a fork.

dimensions.title: 包装边界
dimensions.summary: Secrets stay out of the installer. Config is URL, paste, and a third path. ESM outside asar cannot see modules inside asar.

dimensions.title: 洞察必须落盘
dimensions.summary: A chat insight is unfinished until it has a gate id, an example, and a changelog line.

dimensions.title: 创造会话七步
dimensions.summary: Diagnose, name the law, plan, red probe, minimum green, verify, land.

dimensions.title: 标准自检
dimensions.summary: This repo passes its own gates. STATUS is generated. Gate ids are two-way consistent.
